ai_providers.note: No AI model provider is named for Inspera Assessment itself, which describes no AI feature. Looked at the product, Graide, Originality, DPA and security pages. source blocked: https://support.inspera.com/hc/en-us
ai_providers.footnote: Inspera Originality's AI-content prediction uses Pangram, Inc., listed as a sub-processor with EEA-only processing.
